data.description:
# Documentation integration for the classic arcade roster

Part of epic **Research classic enemies from the arcade games of old** (AH-0MUYAQ6YH0010G52).
Depends on every implemented archetype child. Cross-cutting docs slice: after
the archetypes ship, the repo's user-facing docs must reference the research
doc and list the new roster, so the direction is discoverable and traceable.

## User story

As a developer or player reading the docs, I want the README, the Game Design
Document and the enemy guide to reference `docs/CLASSIC_ENEMY_RESEARCH.md` and list the new
classic-arcade archetypes, so the roster direction and provenance are
findable without spelunking the worklog.

## Scope

- `README.md` - reference `docs/CLASSIC_ENEMY_RESEARCH.md` and the new archetypes.
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` - section 4.1 (Enemy Types) and section 8
  (Future Scope) reflect the new roster / deferral note.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` - section 1 catalog gains the new
  archetype rows, traced to `docs/CLASSIC_ENEMY_RESEARCH.md`.
- Any docs-site / wiki entries discoverable in the repo.
- Verify the per-archetype code comments added by the archetype children are
  present and accurate.

## Key Files

- `README.md` - Updated. Roster / research-doc reference.
- `docs/Game Design Document.md` - Updated. Section 4.1 and section 8.
- `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` - Updated. Section 1 catalog.
- `src/enemyRosterDocs.test.ts` - New or extended docs guard for the cross-links.

## Acceptance Criteria

- All related documentation is updated to reflect the research and the implemented archetypes, including code comments, `README.md`, `docs/Game Design Document.md` sections 4.1/8 and `docs/ENEMY_DESIGN_AND_IMPLEMENTATION.md` section 1, plus any relevant wiki or docs-site entries.
- A docs guard test asserts the README, GDD and enemy guide each reference `docs/CLASSIC_ENEMY_RESEARCH.md` and that the enemy catalog lists the implemented archetypes; the guard fails if a cross-link is removed.
- Full project test suite passes with the documentation changes.
